title: "Learning Curve Extrapolation Design Sketch"
output: html_document

```{r active_learning_run, eval = FALSE}
library("celecx")

objective <- ObjectiveRFun$new(
  fun = function(xs) list(y = sin(xs$x * pi)),
  domain = ps(x = p_dbl(lower = 0, upper = 2)),
  codomain = ps(y = p_dbl(tags = "learn"))
)

optimizer <- optimizer_active_learning(
  learner = mlr3::lrn(
    "regr.km",
    covtype = "matern5_2",
    control = list(trace = FALSE)
  ),
  se_method = "auto",
  batch_size = 2L,
  acq_evals = 250L,
  acq_optimizer = clx_sps("sobol"),
  multipoint_method = "diversity"
)

result <- optimize_active(
  objective = objective,
  n_evals = 100,
  optimizer = optimizer
)
```

## Active-Learning Optimizers

```{r optimizers, eval = FALSE}
make_gp_learner <- function() {
  mlr3::lrn(
    "regr.km",
    covtype = "matern5_2",
    control = list(trace = FALSE)
  )
}

make_rf_learner <- function() {
  mlr3::lrn(
    "regr.ranger",
    num.trees = 100L,
    min.node.size = 2L,
    num.threads = 1L
  )
}

optimizers <- list(
  uncertainty_diversity = optimizer_active_learning(
    learner = make_gp_learner(),
    se_method = "auto",
    batch_size = 4L,
    acq_evals = 250L,
    acq_optimizer = clx_sps("lhs"),
    multipoint_method = "diversity"
  ),
  pool_igs = optimizer_pool_al(
    method = "igs",
    learner = make_rf_learner(),
    n_init = 8L,
    batch_size = 2L,
    pool_size = 500L
  ),
  pool_qbc = optimizer_pool_al(
    method = "qbc",
    learner = make_rf_learner(),
    n_init = 8L,
    k_qbc = 8L,
    batch_size = 2L,
    pool_size = 500L
  )
)
```

## Callback To LCE Task

```{r callback_to_task, eval = FALSE}
holdout_dt <- data.table::data.table(x = seq(0, 2, length.out = 400L))
holdout_dt[, y := objective$fun(list(x = x))$y]
holdout_task <- mlr3::as_task_regr(holdout_dt, target = "y")

surrogate_id_for_callback <- function(optimizer) {
  surrogate_ids <- names(optimizer$surrogates)
  if ("uncertainty" %in% surrogate_ids) {
    return("uncertainty")
  }
  if ("model" %in% surrogate_ids) {
    return("model")
  }
  NA_character_
}

run_with_lce_task <- function(id, optimizer) {
  perf <- mlr3misc::clbk(
    "celecx.surrogate_performance",
    surrogate_id = surrogate_id_for_callback(optimizer),
    task = holdout_task,
    measures = list(
      rmse = mlr3::msr("regr.rmse"),
      mae = mlr3::msr("regr.mae")
    )
  )

  result <- optimize_active(
    objective = objective,
    n_evals = 100L,
    optimizer = optimizer,
    callbacks = list(perf)
  )

  list(
    result = result,
    performance = perf$data,
    task = perf$task(
      measure = "rmse",
      id = sprintf("surrogate_rmse_%s", id)
    )
  )
}

lce_runs <- Map(run_with_lce_task, names(optimizers), optimizers)
names(lce_runs) <- names(optimizers)

lce_tasks <- lapply(lce_runs, function(run) run$task)
names(lce_tasks) <- names(lce_runs)
```

## Benchmark LCE Methods

```{r lce_benchmark, eval = FALSE}
lce_learners <- list(
  rolling_slope = mlr3::lrn("lce.rolling_slope", window = 4L),
  exponential = mlr3::lrn("lce.parametric_exponential"),
  bootstrap_exponential = mlr3::lrn(
    "lce.bootstrap",
    learner = mlr3::lrn("lce.parametric_exponential"),
    n_bootstrap = 200L
  )
)

lce_resampling <- mlr3::rsmp(
  "lce.expanding_cv",
  min_train_batches = 6L,
  horizon = 2L,
  step_size = 1L
)

lce_design <- mlr3::benchmark_grid(
  tasks = lce_tasks,
  learners = lce_learners,
  resamplings = lce_resampling
)

lce_bmr <- mlr3::benchmark(
  lce_design,
  store_models = TRUE
)

lce_bmr$aggregate(
  mlr3::msrs(c("lce.rmse", "lce.mae"))
)
```

## Forecast Remaining Evaluations

```{r forecast_budget, eval = FALSE}
selected_run <- lce_runs$uncertainty_diversity
selected_task <- selected_run$task

forecaster <- mlr3::lrn(
  "lce.bootstrap",
  learner = mlr3::lrn("lce.parametric_exponential"),
  predict_type = "se",
  n_bootstrap = 200L
)
forecaster$train(selected_task)

last_batch <- max(selected_task$batch_nrs)
future_batches <- data.table::data.table(
  batch_nr = as.integer(seq.int(last_batch + 1L, last_batch + 25L))
)

forecast <- forecaster$predict_newdata(future_batches)
forecast_dt <- data.table::data.table(
  batch_nr = future_batches$batch_nr,
  rmse = forecast$response,
  se = forecast$se
)

target_rmse <- 0.03
first_target_batch <- forecast_dt[rmse <= target_rmse, batch_nr][1L]
remaining_batches <- first_target_batch - last_batch

batch_size <- selected_run$result$optimizer$param_set$values$batch_size
if (is.null(batch_size)) {
  batch_size <- 1L
}

remaining_evals <- remaining_batches * batch_size
remaining_evals
```
